project.name: startgg-oauth2-full
project.description: TypeScript OAuth2 PKCE toolkit for Start.gg API with RFC 6749, 6750, 7636 compliance. Zero-dependency, cross-runtime (Node 18+, browsers). Includes PKCE S256, Bearer token handling, scope validation, and ready-to-use examples for Node, Next.js, Discord.js, Vite, and vanilla browser.

examples.name: Node CLI
examples.description: Interactive CLI that opens browser, catches redirect, exchanges code for tokens

examples.name: Node Redirect Server
examples.description: Local HTTP server that handles OAuth callback automatically

examples.name: Browser (Vite)
examples.description: Vanilla browser SPA with PKCE flow and sessionStorage persistence

examples.name: Vite Minimal
examples.description: Minimal Vite scaffold showing authorize URL generation

examples.name: Next.js App Router
examples.description: Next.js server actions with secure callback handling and pending state store

examples.name: Discord.js Bot
examples.description: Discord bot with slash command to start OAuth, HTTP callback server, DM results

features: High-entropy code verifier (43-128 chars, RFC 7636 compliant)
RFC 6749 scope validation (assume unchanged when omitted)
RFC 6750 BearerToken helper with skew-aware expiry
Cross-runtime: Node 18+, browsers, Cloudflare Workers, Deno, Bun
